# Terminal Transfer INC.

Terminal Transfer INC. is a Warehousing and Storage company. Terminal Transfer Inc. is a warehousing and transportation company based in Portland, Oregon, and Seattle, Washington. They offer services such as import, export, transloading, 3PL distribution, special projects, customs, storage, transportation, and areas of service. Terminal Transfer INC. employs 56 people, founded in 1995. Headquartered in Portland, Oregon, United States, with an office in Kent.

## About

Terminal Transfer Inc. is a transportation and warehousing company that has been serving the NW since 1995 with the highest quality in warehousing and transportation. We currently have three facilities located in Portland, OR offering over 375,000sq.ft, with our headquarters located at 15745 North Lombard Street which is less than one half of a mile from Terminal 6, the Port of Portland container terminal. 

Terminal Transfer Inc. also services the Seattle, WA area with a facility located at 25802 74th Ave South in Kent, WA conveniently located near SeaTac. Our facility includes 34 dock height doors, and 3 grade level doors totaling 75,000 sq.ft. Both of our customs bonded CFS warehouses are open Monday thru Friday, 8:00 am to 4:30 pm and after hours on request.

Our Portland and Seattle services include container drayage in Oregon, Washington, and Idaho, trans-loading, de-vanning, and storage of containers; containerized freight, local airfreight and LCL pick-up and delivery. We also pride ourselves in warehousing, distribution, pick and pack, and your consolidation needs. We are also capable of handling all C.E.S. exams for U.S. Customs in our Portland facility.

We handle all of our own transportation in house with over 25 class A CDL tandem tractors. Our drivers are TWIC, Hazardous and TSA certified which allows us to service your needs whether it is airfreight or ocean freight, FCL or LCL. Our fleet also consists of heavy haul equipment, flatbeds, curtain-vans, and van style trailers.

Terminal Transfer Inc. strives to provide the best quality customer service, experience, and dedication to all of our customers in every aspect of the industry. We are able to customize our services and procedures to accommodate your needs as requested.

Need logistics support? 📞 Call us: +1 503-288-7164

# Oregon Transfer Co.

Oregon Transfer Co. is a Warehousing and Storage company. Oregon Transfer Co. employs 18 people (+5.9% YoY, +1 person), founded in 1868. Headquartered in Portland, Oregon, United States.

## About

Oregon Transfer Co. is a family-owned, full service third party logistics (3PL) company established in Portland, Oregon in 1868. We offer you a long history of providing reliable logistics services, working in partnership so you can focus on your core competencies and leave your regional logistics challenges to us. We focus on friendly, open communications so you know we’re taking care of your business throughout the supply chain. That’s the value-add we bring to you as business partners, helping you achieve your goals.

Our customers consider us the premier operator in the Northwest and one of the leaders in the logistics industry. While equipped with the capabilities of our largest competitors, Oregon Transfer Co. retains the agility and responsiveness of a small operation. With almost 150 years in the business, we’re the oldest and largest logistics company in the region. Our senior management team has 100+ combined years of industry experience that you can rely on. In fact, all of our staff is highly knowledgeable and tenured, ready to provide you with personalized service.

We own and operate food grade and light industrial warehouse facilities with reliable storage and handling services for a variety of food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, industrial and general merchandise clients. Our facilities are secured and monitored 24/7. We provide transportation services to and from our multiple facilities. Our Special Projects Division offers value-added services including shrink-wrapping, module-display building, kitting, repacking, etc. These customized specialization programs offer you flexibility, efficiency and level of service that are difficult to achieve with in-house programs. Our job is to serve as the final quality control check for your products.
